Group rides in Arizona

30 recurring group rides around Arizona: 16 road, 7 mountain bike, 7 social. 17 roll on weeknights, 14 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Monday Night Meander in Peoria — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? The Shootout runs a 22–28+ mph; Scootout 19–23 mph; Old-Old Man 16–20 mph.
